design.equivalence_standard: A post-resume decision stream (absolute ticks 150..299) byte-equal to A-PRIME ticks 150..299
design.decision_stream_fields: per actor per absolute tick: action, applied, reward, policy entropy pre/post update, forced-exploration flag, controller flag, effective entropy weight, stockpile; world rows add verb, source, RNG-drawn tile note, prob, entropy. Wall-clock and identity fields are deliberately excluded -- see run-live.js appendDecision.

equivalence_A_vs_Aprime.standard: byte-equal decision stream over ticks 150..299 in every replicate

per_replicate.name: rep0: A POST-RESUME vs A-PRIME (ticks 150..300) -- EQUIVALENCE STANDARD
rep1: A POST-RESUME vs A-PRIME (ticks 150..300) -- EQUIVALENCE STANDARD

divergence_controls.standard: A must differ replicably from BOTH B (fresh seeds) and C (shuffled streams)

per_control.name: rep0: A vs B (fresh-seed control, ticks 0..300)
rep0: A vs C (shuffled-RNG control, ticks 0..300)
rep1: A vs B (fresh-seed control, ticks 0..300)
rep1: A vs C (shuffled-RNG control, ticks 0..300)

frozen_inputs.standard: no arm may carry an operator-console decision packet

comparisons.name: rep0: A pre-checkpoint vs A-PRIME (ticks 0..150)
comparisons.purpose: sanity: identical seeds and identical start must already agree before any resume happens

comparisons.name: rep0: A POST-RESUME vs A-PRIME (ticks 150..300) -- EQUIVALENCE STANDARD
comparisons.purpose: the plan's equivalence standard: resume must be a true continuation, byte-equal on the decision stream

comparisons.name: rep0: A vs B (fresh-seed control, ticks 0..300)
comparisons.purpose: divergence control: different root seeds must produce a different trajectory

comparisons.name: rep0: A vs C (shuffled-RNG control, ticks 0..300)
comparisons.purpose: divergence control: same root seed, permuted per-stream assignment -- isolates state from seeds

comparisons.name: rep1: A pre-checkpoint vs A-PRIME (ticks 0..150)
comparisons.purpose: sanity: identical seeds and identical start must already agree before any resume happens

comparisons.name: rep1: A POST-RESUME vs A-PRIME (ticks 150..300) -- EQUIVALENCE STANDARD
comparisons.purpose: the plan's equivalence standard: resume must be a true continuation, byte-equal on the decision stream

comparisons.name: rep1: A vs B (fresh-seed control, ticks 0..300)
comparisons.purpose: divergence control: different root seeds must produce a different trajectory

comparisons.name: rep1: A vs C (shuffled-RNG control, ticks 0..300)
comparisons.purpose: divergence control: same root seed, permuted per-stream assignment -- isolates state from seeds

comparisons.name: rep0 vs rep1 of arm A (different root seeds)
comparisons.purpose: replication: the equivalence result must not be an artifact of one seed

baseline_comparison.note: r6/r7 are 3000-tick wall-clock-seeded guest runs; only the first 300 ticks are compared, and only on shape. Exact equality is impossible by construction (different seeds) and is not the claim.

divergence_enumeration.standard: the equivalence claim is byte-equality of the DECISION STREAM. These are the places where a resumed run and an uninterrupted one legitimately differ, each named with the reason it cannot feed a decision.

known_divergences.reason: wall-clock stamp; read by nothing in the tick path
wall-clock stamp; encodeState reads only the COUNT of geometry entries (untrained-network.js:145), never their fields
run identity; a resumed run is a new process with new uuids, and arm_id is the --arm label this harness passes (deliberately different per leg). Verified non-feeding in state-inventory.md section 4

counts writes to the world-state FILE. A resume performs one genuine extra write when it materialises the checkpointed world into the sandbox, so a resumed lineage runs exactly one ahead per resume. Produced only; no consumer in the tick path (the dashboard is the sole reader and no arm runs it). The counter remains accurate about what it measures.
wall-clock stamp on the log, not the sim
genesis stamp; carried verbatim through the checkpoint, so a resumed hive keeps the ORIGINAL value and the uninterrupted run has its own

measured.name: rep0: arm A resumed leg final world-state vs A-PRIME final world-state

tiers.name: minus wall-clock, run identity and the world-file write counter
